subject: saffron folded fox
art_direction: 纸狐尖耳与大尾相互呼应，藏金和靛蓝两层纸形成清晰折面。
visible_description: 纸狐尖耳与大尾相互呼应，藏金和靛蓝两层纸形成清晰折面。
composition: Square 1024x1024 avatar. The distinct subject, face, object or abstract form occupies about 65–80% of the canvas, and remains readable at small size. Important features sit safely near the center with room for a circular crop, but DO NOT draw a circular frame, badge, disc backdrop or circular mask. Render a complete square background. Vary silhouette, expression, angle, asymmetry, and density as the individual direction requests. Appealing eyes and a purposeful expression matter when a face is present; never force a face onto a faceless concept.
creative_direction: Build a fox from three layers of cut paper, with saffron outer planes and deep-indigo inner folds. Its large tail wraps around the front paws while the head turns slightly. Use simple incised facial marks and crisp ear tips, balancing pointed shapes with a rounded body. Light the paper from the side to show shallow layer shadows on cream, without a circular backing or forest details. Square 1024x1024, with a clear central silhouette and no circular border. Original peaceful design, no lettering, logos, or watermark.
